applicable_when: This kernel performs a layout transpose from NHWC (in_ptr0 stride: 290400,1,5280,96) to NCHW (out_ptr0 stride: 290400,3025,55,1) while adding a per-channel bias. The L2 cache is saturated at 96.86% while compute is only 28.59%, confirming this is severely memory-bound. The current XBLOCK=128/YBLOCK=8 tiling causes uncoalesced global stores (26.2/32 bytes utilized per sector) because adjacent threads in the X-warp write to out_ptr0 at stride 1 (contiguous) but the Y-dimension (channels) interleaves non-contiguously in the input. The L1 hit rate of 17.46% means almost all accesses miss to L2 (which is saturated). Autotuning tile shapes — particularly increasing YBLOCK to improve input coalescing (channel-major reads) and trying different XBLOCK values — can reduce total sector traffic and improve L2 hit rate. Adding num_stages > 1 enables software pipelining to hide the 21.5-cycle L1TEX latency stalls.
